description:
ABOUT


Monogram is the first visual interface for AI.

Our brains are wired for vision. Half of our neural horsepower is dedicated to visual input. Evolution didn't train us to parse bullet points—it trained us to spot tigers in the bushes. That's why we process visuals 60,000 times faster than text and that’s why we are building Monogram, a visual user interface for AI.

Monogram is the first platform that lets LLMs control the entire user experience. By combining voice with UI generated on the fly, we create an experience that’s far more powerful and engaging than a chatbot. We believe this paradigm will redefine how software is built.

This user experience is consistent, as if a single designer crafted entire flows, hundreds of thousands of different interfaces, just for you, just for what you are trying to do at a moment in time, "on the fly", in just 1 or 2 seconds.

We're a deeply technical team of engineers and designers, tucked away in San Carlos, obsessively shaping the next interface for AI. Backed by top-tier investors behind category-defining companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Airbnb, Robinhood, Stripe, DoorDash, Shopify, and Slack.


YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You’re early in your career — recently graduated or in your first role — and hungry to build more.
   

 - You have a strong foundation in CS, math, physics or engineering from a top school or you’re an autodidact who mastered a field on his/her own terms.
   

 - You participated in highly selective competitions such as national or international olympiads in math / CS / physics, AMC/AIME, engineering contests, Kaggle competitions, Quant olympiads, hackathons, etc..
   

 - You’re a builder at heart — the kind of person who spends weekends hacking on side projects, prototyping ideas or reading science papers.
   

 - You stood out academically — maybe as a Fulbright recipient, a top student in your department.
   

 - You learn fast, take initiative, are driven by curiosity and thrive in ambiguity.
   


WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Developing the core AI technology and graphical user interfaces that will change how people interact with AI.
   

 - Collaborate with a like-minded, experienced team on solving problems in uncharted domains.
